p.title: Thanksgiving Eve NYC 2026: A Night-Out Plan
p.h1: Thanksgiving Eve NYC 2026: happy hour first, then the party, then home

picks.why: A bar with a rooftop on Cypress Avenue in Bushwick, about three minutes on foot from The Chocolate Factory and four from Elsewhere and SILO Brooklyn. Its happy hour runs Tuesday through Friday in the early evening, Wednesday included, and takes money off everything, the simplest deal on this list. Jefferson Street on the L is four minutes away, so it works as the meeting point before any of the three Bushwick parties.

A bar on Wyckoff Avenue, a minute from Jefferson Street on the L and about four minutes from Elsewhere. Its weekday happy hour, Wednesday included, runs in the early evening and leans on food combos: Korean crispy boneless chicken with disco potatoes and a Sura Spritz, vegetable kimbap with two shots of soju, or a crispy miso cod taco with a white peach highball. Eat here before a long night. Reservations are on Resy.

The bar on Bushwick Avenue that hosts Date Nite: Vinyl Happy Hour on Thanksgiving Eve, a minute from Montrose Avenue on the L. Its regular happy hour runs every day until the early evening and takes money off all drinks, so you can catch the deal and the records in one stop. Post No Bills is next door for a second round, and The Meadows is about a six-minute walk.

A bar on Bushwick Avenue next door to Sleepwalk, one minute from Montrose Avenue on the L. Its happy hour runs every day and lasts into the evening, later than most picks here, with drafts, Budweiser and Miller High Life, well drinks, house cocktails, a beer and shot, margaritas in grapefruit, cucumber jalapeno, fresh lime and elderflower versions, and a Negroni. The Meadows is about a six-minute walk.

A pub on Kent Avenue about two minutes on foot from Superior Ingredients, where Flashback with Louie Vega plays on Thanksgiving Eve. Happy hour runs Monday to Friday from late afternoon into the early evening, with the house Kent Pilsner, and the bar also lists an all-night mystery beer or seltzer with a shot, at the bartender's choice. Bedford Avenue on the L is seven minutes away.

A cocktail bar on Eleventh Avenue in West Chelsea, about four minutes on foot from Marquee New York, where Twinsick plays on Thanksgiving Eve. Happy hour runs every day from the afternoon into the early evening, Wednesday included, with a list of house cocktails: a salty dog, a daiquiri, a porn star martini, a dirty martini and a Tommy's margarita. 34th Street-Hudson Yards on the 7 is six minutes away.

p.description: Thanksgiving Eve NYC on Wednesday, Nov 25, 2026: 22 parties on our list, and bars with a Wednesday happy hour near them in Bushwick, Williamsburg and Chelsea.
p.answer: Thanksgiving Eve NYC 2026 is Wednesday, November 25, the night before Thanksgiving on Thursday the 26th. Our list has 22 parties that night, most of them in Bushwick (Elsewhere, SILO Brooklyn, The Chocolate Factory, LISTEN), Williamsburg (Superior Ingredients, Signal, The Meadows, Sleepwalk), the Lower East Side (The DL, The Delancey, VIRGO, ArtSpace) and Chelsea (Marquee New York, Somewhere Nowhere NYC, Music For A While). Start at a bar with a Wednesday happy hour near your party: Vacations or SURA in Bushwick, Post No Bills or Kent Ale House in Williamsburg, or Porchlight in Chelsea.
p.intro: The Wednesday before Thanksgiving is a night when a lot of people are back in town, off work the next day and looking for each other. Thanksgiving falls on Thursday, November 26, 2026, which puts Thanksgiving Eve on Wednesday, November 25. This guide is a plan for the whole night: where to start on a happy hour, which party to walk to, and how to get home. The parties themselves have their own page. Our Thanksgiving Eve parties list keeps the full lineup current as new nights are announced; on November 16 it had 22 published parties for November 25, up from seven when this guide first ran in October. Here we use them to anchor the plan, and pick six bars with a Wednesday happy hour and published deals a few minutes on foot from one of the venues. The idea is simple. Pick your party first, have a cheap first round and some food a few blocks away, then walk over. The next day is a holiday for many people, so there is no need to rush the start.

sections.body: Work backward from the party. Eighteen of the 22 Thanksgiving Eve nights on our list start between 10 and 11 p.m., and the happy hours near them end by the early evening, with Post No Bills the late exception. That leaves a gap, and it is the right gap: first round on a deal, then dinner, then the walk over. Stay in one neighborhood. The parties cluster in Bushwick, Williamsburg, the Lower East Side and Chelsea, and every pick below is within a few minutes on foot of at least one venue. Crossing from Chelsea to Bushwick mid-night costs you time you will want later. Twenty of the 22 parties are listed as 21 and over, and the other two do not state an age, so bring a valid ID. Our guide to what time bars close in NYC covers which IDs New York bars accept and how late they can serve.

sections.h: Bushwick: four dance floors near the L
sections.body: Bushwick has the deepest Thanksgiving Eve lineup on our list, with three venues within a couple of minutes of each other off the Jefferson Street L stop. DayBreak with Woah Nelliee, Hugh Miles and Travis George is at Elsewhere, Tony Guerra and Luquez b2b Maria Sifontes play a house night at SILO Brooklyn, and Soul In The Horn with Natasha Diggs and Friends brings disco, funk, soul, hip-hop and house to The Chocolate Factory. All three start at 10 p.m. Earlier, Oscar G plays LISTEN from 8 p.m. For the pre-game, Vacations Bar & Rooftop is the closest pick to the three Jefferson Street venues, and SURA on Wyckoff Avenue is the one to choose if you need to eat.

sections.h: Williamsburg: from vinyl to reggaeton to Louie Vega
sections.body: The Williamsburg side gives you an early start and a wide spread of music. Date Nite: Vinyl Happy Hour at Sleepwalk on Bushwick Avenue is a funk and soul night from 6 p.m. Next door, Post No Bills keeps its happy hour going into the evening. Later, Reggaeton Throwbacks opens at The Meadows on Meadow Street at 10 p.m., about six minutes on foot from both bars, and Hector Romero and Robbie Lumpkin play house at Signal. Near the waterfront, Flashback with Louie Vega plays disco and house at Superior Ingredients on Wythe Avenue from 10 p.m. Kent Ale House is two minutes away for a first round. The Montrose Avenue and Bedford Avenue stops are both on the L, so you can do the vinyl hour early and still ride over for Louie Vega.

The Lower East Side has the most new nights since October. The DL has two Friendsgiving parties, a Bollywood night and a reggaeton night; The Delancey has Blackout Wednesday, reggaeton and dancehall; and there are Thanksgiving Eve nights at VIRGO and ArtSpace, a house night. In the Financial District, Laissez Faire runs its own Thanksgiving Eve party. All of them start at 10 p.m.

sections.h: Manhattan: Chelsea, Midtown and Hell's Kitchen
sections.body: If you would rather stay in Manhattan, Chelsea has three: Twinsick at Marquee New York on Tenth Avenue from 11 p.m., Thanksgiving Eve 2026 at Somewhere Nowhere NYC and Thanksgiving Eve at Music For A While, both from 10 p.m. Porchlight on Eleventh Avenue is about four minutes from Marquee and runs its happy hour every day. In Midtown, Nebula has Black(out) Wednesday from 11 p.m.; in Hell's Kitchen, Diego Garcia and friends play Althea's Hideaway. For a day start, 230 Fifth Rooftop in Flatiron lists a Thanksgiving Eve party from noon.

The MTA says the subway runs 24 hours a day, every day, but not every line runs at all times, and late-night routes can change. Check the MTA app before you leave the party. The Brooklyn picks here sit on the L, according to their listings, and Porchlight is closest to the 7 at 34th Street-Hudson Yards. Thursday, November 26, is Thanksgiving Day, a federal holiday on the OPM schedule and a holiday on New York City's 2026 holiday calendar. If you want to keep going, Groundcontrol Presents: Thanksgiving with KOFLA and Cristian Arango plays Superior Ingredients on Thursday night, the one party on our list that night. For what is open in the day, see what's open on Thanksgiving in NYC. Happy hours on the holiday itself are a different story, so check the cards before you count on one.

faq.a: Wednesday, November 25, 2026. Thanksgiving Day falls on Thursday, November 26, according to the federal holiday schedule published by the U.S. Office of Personnel Management.

faq.q: What parties are on Thanksgiving Eve in NYC?
faq.a: Our list had 22 published parties for November 25 on November 16, among them Flashback with Louie Vega at Superior Ingredients, DayBreak at Elsewhere, Soul In The Horn at The Chocolate Factory, Tony Guerra at SILO Brooklyn, Oscar G at LISTEN, Twinsick at Marquee New York and Black(out) Wednesday at Nebula. The Thanksgiving Eve parties page keeps the list current.

faq.q: Which bars have a happy hour on the Wednesday before Thanksgiving?
faq.a: Near the parties, Vacations Bar & Rooftop and SURA in Bushwick, Sleepwalk, Post No Bills and Kent Ale House in Williamsburg, and Porchlight in Chelsea all list a Wednesday happy hour. These are their regular schedules; we could not confirm holiday-eve hours.

faq.q: Are Thanksgiving Eve parties 21 and over?
faq.a: Twenty of the 22 parties on our list for November 25 are listed as 21 and over, and the other two do not state an age. Bring a valid government ID or passport.

faq.q: Does the subway run late on Thanksgiving Eve?
faq.a: Yes, the MTA runs the subway 24 hours a day, but not every line runs at all times. Check the MTA app for late-night service before you head home.

faq.q: Is there a party on Thanksgiving night itself?
faq.a: Yes, one on our list: Groundcontrol Presents: Thanksgiving with KOFLA and Cristian Arango at Superior Ingredients in Williamsburg on Thursday, November 26.

p.method: The Thanksgiving date comes from the U.S. Office of Personnel Management's federal holiday schedule and New York City's 2026 holiday calendar, and subway hours from the MTA's rider guide, checked October 23, 2026. Parties come from our published party listings for November 25 and 26, 2026, counted on November 16, 2026, with venue addresses from our venue records; party times are shown in New York time. Bars come from our database of New York happy hours, which records each bar's schedule and offers from its own website; the six picks were last checked between September 2 and November 11, 2026.

p.title: Thanksgiving Weekend NYC 2026: Parties and Happy Hours
p.h1: Thanksgiving Weekend NYC 2026: Where to Go Out, Wednesday to Sunday

picks.why: Sea Wolf sits at 19 Wyckoff Avenue, a minute from the Jefferson St L stop and on the same avenue as House of Yes. Its happy hour runs every day of the week, so Wednesday, Friday, Saturday and Sunday are all covered on the regular schedule, with beers, house wine and frozen drinks on the deal. The venue also hosts the MONSTERA reggaeton party on Friday and Saturday nights.

OTB at 141 Broadway in Williamsburg runs a weeknight happy hour plus a weekend one from midday into the afternoon, which makes it a good Saturday or Sunday warm-up before Superior Ingredients or a Sunday roof session. The deal covers margaritas, martinis, Aperol spritz, house wine, half a dozen oysters and a cheeseburger. Marcy Avenue on the J, M and Z is a 6-minute walk.

p.table_title: Happy hours open on Saturday and Sunday
p.description: Thanksgiving weekend NYC 2026, night by night: 85 parties from Wednesday to Sunday, Thursday after dinner, Saturday's 34 club nights, and weekend happy hours.
p.answer: Thanksgiving weekend NYC nights run from Wednesday, November 25 to Sunday, November 29, 2026, with 85 published parties on our calendar: 22 on Wednesday, 1 on Thursday, 24 on Friday, 34 on Saturday and 4 on Sunday. Wednesday has Louie Vega's Flashback at Superior Ingredients, and Thursday has Ground Control's Thanksgiving night with KOFLA and Cristian Arango. Friday brings Guy Gerber at Pacha New York, Saturday has Felix Da Housecat at House of Yes and Mathame at Pacha, and Sunday opens with Chus & Ceballos at Superior Ingredients.
p.intro:
Thanksgiving falls on Thursday, November 26 this year, and the party calendar wraps around it. Wednesday is busy, Thursday is quiet until dinner is cleared, and Saturday is the fullest night. Sunday leans toward daytime parties.

This guide walks the five nights in order, with the numbers as of November 16, 2026, more than twice the 40 nights on the calendar when it first ran in October. Each party links to its own page with live ticket status and price. Of the 85, 78 are listed as 21+, one as 18+ and six state no age; one, MPH at Knockdown Center, was sold out on DICE. For happy hours we use each bar's regular weekly schedule, so check holiday hours, above all on Thursday.

sections.h: Wednesday, November 25: the big night out
sections.body: Twenty-two published parties land on Wednesday, and ten are billed around Thanksgiving. Our Thanksgiving Eve guide covers this night in full, so here is the short version. Louie Vega plays Flashback at Superior Ingredients from 10 PM, Soul In The Horn runs at The Chocolate Factory, and DayBreak plays Elsewhere in Bushwick. If you want music without the late night, Date Nite: Vinyl Happy Hour at Sleepwalk on Bushwick Avenue starts at 6 PM, and Oscar G plays LISTEN in Bushwick from 8 PM.

Thanksgiving night is the quietest night on the calendar. Ground Control's party with KOFLA and Cristian Arango at Superior Ingredients is the only published party for Thursday, from 10 PM. Bars are harder to call. On a normal week, 826 of the 841 bars we track list a Thursday happy hour, but holiday hours are not in our data. Check the bar's own site or call before you head out, and see what's open on Thanksgiving for the attractions that say they close that day.

sections.h: Friday and Saturday, November 27 and 28: the weekend proper
sections.body: Friday has 24 published parties and Saturday has 34, the busiest night of the five. On Friday, Guy Gerber plays Pacha New York, Sidepiece plays Marquee New York, Night & Day takes Signal, and Funk Flex hosts Divas & Dons: Black Friday at Paragon. Saturday spreads across three boroughs. Felix Da Housecat plays House of Yes, Mathame plays Pacha New York, Derrick Carter plays Pressure at Paragon, and Galcher Lustwerk plays live at Signal. UK garage producer MPH at Knockdown Center in Maspeth was sold out on DICE on November 16. For an early start, Suave Saturdays at Somewhere Nowhere NYC is a Latin sunset party from 5 PM, and Bear Tea Dance at C'mon Everybody and This is 40ish on the Lower East Side start at 6 PM.

sections.h: Happy hours open over the long weekend
sections.body:
Weekend happy hours are rarer than weekday ones. Of the 841 bars on yaynyc, 309 list a Saturday happy hour and 344 list a Sunday one, and 273 cover Wednesday, Friday, Saturday and Sunday on their regular schedule. The table below has live times and prices.

A few bars pair well with the parties above. Sea Wolf on Wyckoff Avenue runs its happy hour every day and sits on the same avenue as House of Yes, so it works before Saturday's Felix Da Housecat night. OTB on Broadway in Williamsburg has a weekend happy hour, a natural first stop before Sunday at Superior Ingredients. These are regular schedules, so a quick look at the bar's site saves a wasted trip.

sections.h: Sunday, November 29 and tips for the whole weekend
sections.body: Sunday has four published parties, and three of them are daytime. Chus & Ceballos play Superior Ingredients from 2 PM, Friendsgiving in DUMBO at 26 Bridge starts at 3 PM, and in Gowanus, Eli Escobar and Jen Cardini take The Atrium at Public Records from 4 PM. Loco Carnaval at Somewhere Nowhere NYC runs late. A few rules apply across the weekend. Most parties are 21+, so bring a valid government ID. Ticket prices change, so check each party page for the current price before you buy.

faq.q: What is open on Thanksgiving night in NYC?
faq.a: Ground Control's Thanksgiving party with KOFLA and Cristian Arango at Superior Ingredients in Williamsburg is the only published party on Thursday, November 26, 2026, from 10 PM. Bars list regular Thursday happy hours, but holiday hours are not confirmed, so check each bar's site before you go.

faq.q: Which night of Thanksgiving weekend has the most parties?
faq.a: Saturday, November 28 has the most, with 34 published parties. Friday has 24, Wednesday has 22, Sunday has 4 and Thanksgiving Thursday has 1, for 85 across the five nights as of November 16.

faq.q: Are there daytime or early parties over Thanksgiving weekend?
faq.a: Yes. On Wednesday, Date Nite at Sleepwalk starts at 6 PM; on Saturday, Suave Saturdays starts at 5 PM and Bear Tea Dance and This is 40ish at 6 PM; on Sunday, Chus & Ceballos start at 2 PM, Friendsgiving in DUMBO at 3 PM and The Atrium at Public Records at 4 PM.

faq.q: Can I go to Thanksgiving weekend parties if I am under 21?
faq.a: Mostly not. Of the 85 parties, 78 are listed as 21+, one (Cabros Chicos at Bar 13 on Saturday) as 18+, and six state no age. Bring a valid physical ID.

faq.q: Do NYC bars keep happy hour over Thanksgiving weekend?
faq.a: Many do on their regular schedule: 309 bars on yaynyc list a Saturday happy hour and 344 list a Sunday one. Holiday changes are not in our data, so confirm with the bar, especially on Thanksgiving Day.

p.method: Party facts come from yaynyc's published party listings for November 25 to 29, 2026, as read from each event's ticket page and noted on every party page. Party counts (85 total, one sold out) and bar counts (841 live bars; 309 with a Saturday and 344 with a Sunday happy hour) were computed from our data on November 16, 2026. Bar details come from each bar's own website (Sea Wolf checked October 27, OTB November 16, 2026). Holiday hours for bars are not confirmed.
